title: Black Pepper for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Black Pepper & Piperine for Hair: Research, Safety & Interactions | FullyVital
seo_description: No human trial tests black pepper on hair. See what lab and mouse studies found, and what a safety review says about piperine and drug interactions.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Merge target; redirected posts unsourced, nothing carried over. No human hair data; article is explicit.
flags: Hirata is in-vitro and mouse work; stated plainly. 'Anti-androgenic' is the authors' term.
Shoba is a curcumin study, used only to show piperine's effect on absorption.
'Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking piperine' is general advice supported by the interaction review.
